title: UEFA threatens World Cup boycott over FIFA investor deal
desc: Europe's football associations have unanimously threatened to boycott the World Cup if FIFA goes ahead with a planned deal to sell commercial rights to private investors, UEFA said after an emergency meeting on Thursday. The European governing body said in an official statement that no UEFA national team would take part in any FIFA competition for as long as the proposals remained in place.
